splitting_rule_if_future_experiment_is_a: Assign all observations from a parent group to one partition. Fit all preprocessing inside training folds. Keep any calibration and final evaluation group-disjoint. Do not use full-dataset residual outlier flags as a prospective exclusion criterion.
